configurePresets.name: linux-core
configurePresets.description: Configure the pure-C++ core with the OCCT geometry kernel and Polyhedral-FEA mesher.

configurePresets.name: windows-core
configurePresets.displayName: Windows core (libchudware, Ninja + MSVC, OCCT off)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with MSVC. Run from an 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022' (or after vcvars64.bat) so cl/link are on PATH. OCCT off = the self-contained fast build; verified on Win11 + MSVC 14.44. See docs/BUILD_WINDOWS.md.

configurePresets.name: windows-occt
configurePresets.displayName: Windows core + OCCT (libchudware, Ninja + MSVC, OCCT on)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with OCCT and Polyhedral-FEA on MSVC. The first configure downloads OCCT and the pinned BSD-3-Clause mesher source. Run from an x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64
configurePresets.displayName: macOS arm64 core (libchudware, Ninja + AppleClang, OCCT + Polyhedral-FEA)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with Homebrew OpenCASCADE and the pinned Polyhedral-FEA source. CEF is disabled because no Darwin CEF distribution is vendored.

configurePresets.name: macos-x86_64
configurePresets.displayName: macOS x86_64 core (libchudware, Ninja + AppleClang, OCCT + Polyhedral-FEA)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with Homebrew OpenCASCADE and the pinned Polyhedral-FEA source. CEF is disabled because no Darwin CEF distribution is vendored.
